tagline: The right tool for Napier's outdoor jobs
heroSubheading: Your neighbourhood shop for outdoor power equipment, servicing and advice
aboutHtml:
Hayden and Victoria Buckman have run STIHL SHOP Greenmeadows since 2014. They set up the shop because Napier and the wider region needed a reliable place to buy quality equipment and get proper support when things need fixing or maintaining.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Honda Power Equipment and other trusted brands. We offer online and instore sales, full workshop servicing for repairs and maintenance, and we supply and install woodfires for homes across the district. Whether you need advice on the right equipment or professional support keeping it running, we've got you covered.

We're proud sponsors of local rugby clubs and community events, because we're part of Napier. Come in and see us, and we'll make sure you've got the right tool for the job.
